doc.citation: García Muro, V.J., Rubinstein, C.V., and Steemans, P. 2018. Late Silurian palynomorphs from the Precordillera of San Juan, Argentina: Diversity, palaeoenvironmental and palaeogeographic significance. Acta Palaeontologica Polonica 63(1): 41–61.
doc.comment: The supplied local text and PDF contain only the abstract. Extraction uses the publisher's [full article](https://www.app.pan.pl/archive/published/app63/app004002017.pdf) and [supplement](https://www.app.pan.pl/archive/published/SOM/app63-GarciaMuro_etal_SOM.pdf), including SOM 1–3. Quebrada Ancha material overlaps García Muro et al. (2014b), Upper Silurian miospores from the Precordillera Argentina; Cerro La Chilca material overlaps García Muro and Rubinstein (2015), New biostratigraphic proposal for the Lower Palaeozoic Tucunuco Group. Taxon strings follow the supplementary charts unless identified as caption-only. Grey rectangles denote doubtful classification, recorded in notes. Illustrated flags refer to specimens from the particular sample illustrated in this paper. Four barren samples have no individually reported age.
